svg.text: HOW TO MAKE IT AND HOW IT FITS

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Cut 28 x 28 mm of perfboard; file the edges square.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Drill two 2.8 mm holes 12 mm from the scan axis toward the head end,

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 12 mm each side, for M2.5 x 6 screws into the head block.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Hold the board on the head block with the LEDs and photodiode in their

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: pockets and mark where every lead comes through; open those holes.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Build the amplifier, the 24-bit converter and the LED switches on the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: top face as the wiring picture shows; keep the photodiode input short.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: The LED switches include a hardware limit on how long an LED can stay on.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Check: every lead passes through without bending the LED or photodiode.
